detailed_description: The JSON Schema Generator creates a JSON Schema document from one pasted JSON value in the browser. It parses the input with JSON.parse, calls the local generateFullSchema helper, and writes a formatted schema to the output textarea. You can choose Draft-07 or Draft-2020-12, optionally include examples, optionally mark all fields as required, clear the tool, and copy the generated schema. The tool does not accept multiple samples, import files, validate other data against the generated schema, detect date-time formats, perform strict-null analysis, generate recursive references, infer conditional schemas, or guarantee full draft compliance for every advanced JSON Schema feature.
usage_steps: Paste one valid JSON value into the input textarea.
Choose Draft-07 or Draft-2020-12 from the draft dropdown.
Optionally enable examples or mark all fields as required.
Click Generate to create the formatted schema output.
Copy the generated schema, or clear the input and output.
usage_examples: Generate a starter schema from a pasted API response sample.
Compare output with and without example values included.
Mark all fields as required for a stricter draft before manual review.
Copy the formatted schema as a starting point for documentation or validation work.
